resources.title: DevOps Engineer: The Foundation Infographic (1 of 4)
resources.description: What a DevOps Engineer actually does: bringing development and operations together to automate, streamline, and improve how software and data solutions are built, tested, deployed, and run in the cloud. Covers the DevOps lifecycle (plan, code, build, test, release, deploy, operate), the business value of DevOps (faster delivery, more reliable systems, lower costs, higher security, scalable operations), core tools and technologies (Git, GitHub, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Azure, AWS, monitoring), key responsibilities, a real e-commerce application deployment example, career path and salary growth, and the high-level learning roadmap from IT & Linux foundations through monitoring & security.

resources.title: DevOps Engineer: Core Technologies — Linux, Git, Python, Docker & Kubernetes Infographic (2 of 4)
resources.description: The hands-on technical foundation every DevOps Engineer builds: Linux & scripting foundations (navigating systems, files/permissions/users, Bash/Python automation), Git & CI/CD fundamentals (version control, GitHub collaboration, pull requests, pipelines), containers with Docker (images, multi-container apps, registries), Kubernetes orchestration (Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, scaling), how it all works together (code -> build -> deploy -> CI/CD -> monitor), 5 real hands-on labs, the full tools-in-the-pipeline list, and a real architecture example spanning Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud.

resources.title: DevOps Engineer: Infrastructure as Code, Cloud, Monitoring & DevSecOps Infographic (3 of 4)
resources.description: The production-readiness layer of DevOps: infrastructure as code (Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation — provisioning environments consistently), the three major cloud platforms for DevOps (Azure, AWS, Google Cloud) and their equivalent services, monitoring & observability (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack), DevSecOps (integrating security into every pipeline stage — scan, test, build, deploy), scalability & reliability (high availability, auto-scaling, disaster recovery), a real code-to-cloud team scenario, the key skills you'll master, and a realistic 12-week project roadmap from building the foundation to securing/monitoring/presenting.

resources.title: DevOps Engineer: Career Readiness — Project, Certification, and What's Next Infographic (4 of 4)
resources.description: Turning DevOps skills into a real job: the capstone project (a real DevOps platform from code to cloud with Git/GitHub, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, monitoring, and DevSecOps), the recommended certifications (AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional, Microsoft Certified DevOps Engineer Expert/AZ-400, Certified Kubernetes Administrator/CKA), common interview questions, how to build a strong GitHub portfolio, a 5-step job search roadmap, career growth and salary ranges from entry-level through DevOps Architect/Lead, the full tools & platforms recap, and a practical 90-day action plan.
